description: Per-Visium-spot cell-type proportions from REAL Xenium single cells co-registered under Visium spots (Janesick et al. 2023, Nat Commun). NOT pseudo-spots-from-binning: Visium (sequencing) and Xenium (imaging) are SEPARATE measurements of the SAME FFPE breast block, co-registered via the 10x-published affine transform.
platform_reference: Xenium single cells (same assay as GT) - see honest_caveat
coregistration_method: Xenium cell centroids (microns) -> Visium full-resolution pixels via M = M_explorer @ diag(1/0.2125,1/0.2125,1), where M_explorer is the affine matrix exported from Xenium Explorer's H&E registration (10XGenomics/janesick_nature_comms_2023_companion, companion_notebook.ipynb cell 15), and 0.2125 um/px is the Xenium morphology image pixel size (pyramid level 0). Each Xenium cell assigned to nearest Visium spot, kept only if Euclidean distance <= spot_radius (strict 55um footprint containment). Validated: 35.9% of all Xenium cells fall within a spot footprint, matching the Visium hex-grid areal coverage; median 14 cells/spot.
coregistration_difference_from_10x_compa: The 10x companion bins every cell to its NEAREST spot (interpolation, no distance cutoff). We instead require strict 55um-footprint containment (distance<=radius), so cells in the inter-spot gaps are dropped rather than interpolated -> more honest 'cells physically under the spot' proportions.
honest_caveat: REAL cells + REAL co-registration, but NOT a fully orthogonal modality: Xenium cell-type labels are themselves expression-clustering-derived (supervised label transfer from a matched scFFPE/FLEX dataset; GSE243275 'Xenium R1 Fig1-5 (supervised)'). And the reference here is built from Xenium cells (same assay as the GT tally). A fully independent reference would be the matched scFFPE-Seq (FLEX) single-cell data (GSE243275_RAW.tar, 2.86GB, not fetched) - left as a documented upgrade. 'Unlabeled' Xenium cells are excluded from both truth and reference.

anti_leak_checklist.1_truth_only_from_xenium_tallies: PASS - truth_proportions computed solely from Xenium cell centroids + supervised labels tallied under each spot footprint; Visium expression never used.
anti_leak_checklist.2_visium_expression_is_the_deconv_input: PASS - benchmark_spots X = raw Visium UMI counts only.
anti_leak_checklist.3_reference_disjoint_from_truth_cells: PASS - reference cells are labeled Xenium cells NOT assigned to any kept spot (inter-spot/outside-capture cells); zero overlap with cells tallied into truth_proportions.
anti_leak_checklist.4_label_sets_harmonized: PASS - truth columns identical to reference cell_type set: ['B_Cells', 'CD4+_T_Cells', 'CD8+_T_Cells', 'DCIS_1', 'DCIS_2', 'Endothelial', 'IRF7+_DCs', 'Invasive_Tumor', 'LAMP3+_DCs', 'Macrophages_1', 'Macrophages_2', 'Mast_Cells', 'Myoepi_ACTA2+', 'Myoepi_KRT15+', 'Perivascular-Like', 'Prolif_Invasive_Tumor', 'Stromal', 'Stromal_&_T_Cell_Hybrid', 'T_Cell_&_Tumor_Hybrid']
anti_leak_checklist.5_genes_shared: PASS - spots and reference both restricted to the 307 shared Visium-Xenium genes.
